about: What the last mission step shows while the rover drives. `team` is filled in by the team: names are never guessed. `sections` lists only data and tools the app really uses (package.json, data/catalog.json, data/missions.json, data/sites.json, index.html). `site` is the address the QR code under the credits opens; after changing it, remake the picture: swift tools/make-qr.swift "<address>" public/site-qr.svg.
